title: Virtual Compute: snapshot review operation
content:
## Use and effect

Virtual Compute — Record an accountant review of one shared snapshot charge against its allocation evidence. This creates an approved incorrect review containing the corrected local subtotal without posting money. The returned event identifier confirms success.

## Invocation

review_compute_snapshot_6efd32f0 is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameter compute_holding_id

`compute_holding_id`: Id class — The compute contract reference for snapshot review, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings, find_customers or the preceding successful receipt.

## Parameter customer_id

`customer_id`: Id class — The customer profile reference for snapshot review, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings, find_customers or the preceding successful receipt.

## Parameter compute_event_id

`compute_event_id`: Id class — Identifier of the completed compute-attributable snapshot allocation for the original charge, copied from its successful allocation receipt or find_compute_events; use the identical allocation reference supplied in related_event_id.

## Parameter source_event_id

`source_event_id`: Id class — The original snapshot invoice reference for snapshot review, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings, find_customers or the preceding successful receipt.

## Parameter related_event_id

`related_event_id`: Id class — The export, allocation or approved review reference for snapshot review, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings, find_customers or the preceding successful receipt.

## Parameter net_amount

`net_amount`: Fixed-format class — The net_amount in units of USD, representation USD to two decimals; supplied already rounded half-up to two decimal places at calculation completion, with no empty value.

## Successful receipt

The successful string receipt identifies the newly recorded snapshot review by its new business event reference and confirms its approved registration and the business effect described above.
